title: Oozy Sweet Hakka Noodles
description: A malty, gooey, post-workout Chinese dish featuring creme-patissiere, steam, and low-sodium-friendly ingredients, perfect for a satisfying dinner.
instructions: Cook the hakka noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a small saucepan, combine the creme-patissiere, malt syrup, and sesame oil, and heat over low heat, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped scallions, low-sodium soy sauce, and cooked noodles to the saucepan, and stir to combine.
Steam the bok choy until tender and chop into small pieces.
Add the steamed bok choy to the noodle mixture and stir to combine.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a serving dish and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve the oozy sweet hakka noodles hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
Let the dish rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
